description: This PHP source file defines the class AbstractRelationship, which is part of a module in the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM ecosystem. It provides mechanisms to define, manage, and build metadata for relationships between modules, including metadata serialization, relationship definition, label building, and utility functions related to relationship construction and database schema considerations.

classes.name: AbstractRelationship
classes.description: An abstract class providing a framework to define and manipulate module relationships, including metadata handling, label building, relationship metadata generation, and utility functions for relationship construction within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an AbstractRelationship object with a relationship definition array, setting default values for certain keys.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the unique name of the relationship, typically the one provided at construction.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets or updates the relationship's name.

methods.name: readonly
methods.description: Checks if the relationship is marked as read-only.

methods.name: setReadonly
methods.description: Sets the relationship's read-only status.

methods.name: setFromStudio
methods.description: Marks the relationship as defined or modified from Studio.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Checks if the relationship has been marked as deleted.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Marks the relationship as deleted.

methods.name: getFromStudio
methods.description: Returns whether the relationship was set from Studio.

methods.name: getLhsModule
methods.description: Returns the Left-Hand Side module name.

methods.name: getRhsModule
methods.description: Returns the Right-Hand Side module name.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the relationship type.

methods.name: relationship_only
methods.description: Checks if the relationship is configured as relationship-only (without UI components).

methods.name: setRelationship_only
methods.description: Marks the relationship as relationship-only.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the full relationship definition array.

methods.name: buildLabels
methods.description: Constructs labels for the relationship, including module titles for UI.

methods.name: getLeftModuleSystemLabel
methods.description: Returns the system label for the Left-Hand side module.

methods.name: getRightModuleSystemLabel
methods.description: Returns the system label for the Right-Hand side module.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Returns an array of labels used for the relationship display.

methods.name: getSubpanelDefinition
methods.description: Generates a subpanel configuration array for displaying related records.

methods.name: getLinkFieldDefinition
methods.description: Constructs vardef array for a link field in a module for relationships.

methods.name: getLink2FieldDefinition
methods.description: Constructs vardef array for a secondary link field used for relate field mechanics.

methods.name: getRelateFieldDefinition
methods.description: Constructs vardef array for a relate field associated with the relationship.

methods.name: getRelationshipMetaData
methods.description: Builds the complete metadata array for a relationship, including join table info, indices, and relationship properties.

methods.name: getActivitiesSubModuleRelationshipName
methods.description: Generates a relationship name for submodules related to Activities, e.g., Tasks.

methods.name: getValidDBName
methods.description: Returns a database-safe name, constrained by supported DB identifier length.

methods.name: parseRelationshipType
methods.description: Normalizes and returns canonical relationship types from various input forms.

methods.name: getJoinKeyLHS
methods.description: Returns the join key name for the LHS of the relationship.

methods.name: getJoinKeyRHS
methods.description: Returns the join key name for the RHS of the relationship.

methods.name: getIDName
methods.description: Returns the ID field name used to link related records for a given module.

methods.name: getTablename
methods.description: Retrieves the physical database table name for a specified module.

methods.name: getTitleKey
methods.description: Retrieves the title key used for subpanel headers.
